items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: everybody was influenced by Charlie Parker... I used to try to copy him a little bit

ctx.x: Before we get to Ellington, do you consider yourself, were you heavily into bebop at that time? I mean, can you describe your own playing as opposed to someone else describing it?

Well, just like most people playing horns back in those days, everybody was influenced by Charlie Parker. Everybody was trying to play like Bird. Some people even started shooting up dope so they could play like Bird.
Thought that that was the secret.
